payload.claim: Problem item 3 is an intentional, disclosed exit-code change: two aborts in a row immediately before a candidate over budget now ends the batch INFRASTRUCTURE (exit 2) where today it ends BUDGET (exit 0). The spec states and justifies this plainly as the intended outcome, so it costs nothing extra for the cell to build, but it is worth a human's notice at merge time since it changes what launchd or other monitoring sees on this specific, previously exit-0 combination of conditions.
